title: Derived tensor cohomology vanishing for a complex on a ringed site
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site of object universe $u$ and morphism universe $v$, let $\mathcal R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings in universe $\max(u,v)$, let $K^\bullet$ be an arbitrary cochain complex of $\mathcal R$-module sheaves, and let $F$ be an $\mathcal R$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For $i\in\mathbb Z$, define $H^i(K^\bullet\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal R}F)=0$ to mean that there exist a K-flat complex $P^\bullet$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] and a quasi-isomorphism $q:P^\bullet\to K^\bullet$ such that $H^i(\operatorname{Tot}(P^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal R}F[0]))=0$, using the canonical total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There is no boundedness hypothesis. K-flat replacement computes the derived tensor independently of the replacement.
